left.subheading: A virtualized data table for exploring millions of NYC taxi trips

paragraphs: Public datasets like NYC's taxi trip records run into the hundreds of thousands of rows — enough to bring a naive table implementation to its knees. This project explores how to make that kind of scale feel instant.

Rather than paginating or truncating the data, I used TanStack Virtual to render only the rows currently in the viewport (plus a small buffer), so the DOM stays small regardless of dataset size. Column widths are resizable and persisted between sessions, and search/filter state is debounced against a live NYC Open Data API endpoint with request cancellation to avoid race conditions on fast typing.
Stack: Next.js, TanStack Table, TanStack Virtual, NYC Open Data (Socrata) API
